explanation: Assignment operators in C are used to assign values to variables.  They are crucial for storing and manipulating data within a program.  Different assignment operators provide shorthand for common arithmetic operations combined with assignment.

extraction_metadata.source: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie

book: The C Programming Language - Kernighan & Ritchie
code_example:
int x;
int y = 10;
x = y; /* Simple Assignment */

x += 5; /* x = x + 5 */
x -= 2; /* x = x - 2 */
x *= 3; /* x = x * 3 */
x /= 6; /* x = x / 6 */
x %= 4; /* x = x % 4 */

int z = 0b1010;
z &= 0b0111; /* Bitwise AND assignment */
z |= 0b0001; /* Bitwise OR assignment */
z ^= 0b1000; /* Bitwise XOR assignment */
z <<= 2; /* Left shift assignment */
z >>= 1; /* Right shift assignment */
keywords: C assignment operator, operator =, compound assignment
